purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude timed out and Grok returned provider error 402, so external review absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
WM-XCT-020 parentage remains a reference because its direction may be navigational or reversed.
Classified objects, assignments, evidence, policies, workflows, datasets and search indexes remain external masters.
Generic, instance, partitive and informal hierarchy profiles require separate inference, cycle and polyhierarchy rules.
Exact, close, formal class and registry mapping semantics remain distinct and release-pinned.
Language tags, licensed standards, projections and crosswalks require independent validation before stronger conformance claims.
audit_findings: The aggregate boundary is valid because a scheme release owns identity-dependent concepts, labels, relations, collections, mappings and change sets.
Concept identity is kept distinct from the real-world or abstract referent and from each external classification binding.
Broader and narrower relations do not silently imply part-of or formal subclass semantics.
Exact-match and close-match mappings have distinct semantics and cannot be collapsed into generic equivalence.
Immutable releases, explicit change sets and URI continuity preserve deprecation, split, merge and supersession history.
Every mapping records method, source and target versions, confidence and evidence references.
Access, licensing, retention and projection-loss constraints remain explicit publication holds.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
